sections.text_helper: Section 26.7.7 "RNG health test status register 1 (RNG_HTSR1)" in chapter 26 (True random number generator (RNG)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 790.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x024
Reset value: 0x00000000
Bits 31:10 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 9:1 ADERR{i}: Adaptative error for oscillator i (i=1 to 9)
This bit is set when the health test logic associated to the oscillator i finds an adaptative test
error. The bit is cleared when application clears SEIS bit in RNG_SR. If ARDIS is cleared auto-
reset prevents RNG to capture more than one test error. Adaptive proportion test is defined in
Health checks section.
0: No adaptative test error found in oscillator i.
1: Adaptative test error found in oscillator i.
Bit 0 ADERRX: Adaptative error after the XOR
This bit is set when the health test logic finds an adaptative test error after the XOR clock tree
(see Figure173). The bit is cleared when application clears SEIS bit in RNG_SR If ARDIS is
cleared auto-reset prevents RNG to capture more than one test error.
0: No adaptative test error found after the XOR clock tree.
1: Adaptative test error found after the XOR clock tree.
